parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records resides at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the Wallpaper package, which sits under an Examples/SampleApp path and therefore carries sample-app semantics. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where at least one record is a sample-app file must default to no-action. Additionally, both records are anonymous type aliases (name is empty string) with no fields, providing no structural evidence (jaccard, shared_ancestor, and shared_field_count are all null) to motivate a refactor. Coupling the DebugPanel production alias to the WallpaperSampleApp demonstration alias would entangle production code with sample-app semantics.
